status: Native adapter implemented and CPU parity passed; GPU engineering then conditional full500 launched
name: L27 reflection-alternative margin protection
attribution: Own design prompted by VCM scale audit; not official VCM, CGRS, or proof of necessary reflection
hypothesis: The prior-step negative ReBalance coefficient may permit suppression even when the current token distribution strongly prefers a reflection phrase. Reduce suppression at that moment to limit accuracy damage.
only_changed_factor: Magnitude of the existing L27 logit penalty on exactly the same eligible tokens
formula: a=max raw logit among currently masked L27 candidates; b=max raw logit among all other finite tokens; d=max(0,a-b); lambda=max(0,ln2-d). If no finite alternative, lambda=0. Subtract lambda once from currently masked candidates.
fixed_parameters: Reuse ln2 as existing magnitude and gap width. No new tuned scalar. Threshold choice is our design, not validated by the paper.
execution_order: Native ReBalance forward and raw pmax capture unchanged
Obtain unchanged L27 phrase mask and negative-R gate
Measure a,b from raw logits before any penalty, temperature, or top-p
Apply the single replacement penalty in native dtype
Original accepted-token lexical and ReBalance updates
state: No new recurrent state or history. Use existing request mapping and masks. No new model forward or probe. Preserve original reset/removal/replay rules.
integration: B-line adapter.py optional penalty_provider defaults to None, exact legacy arithmetic retained; reflection_margin_adapter.py implements device reductions with native dtype and per-request diagnostics. No shared vLLM changes.
engineering: Before effectiveness: native finite and masked logit checks; exact disabled parity; no pre-intervention divergence; complete existing replay/reset invariants. Existing112 captures have zero original RC14-eligible positions and cannot validate real L27 opportunities.

effectiveness_plan.data: Full MATH500, one new arm, seed42, max_new_tokens16000; reuse frozen U/R/RC14/L27 with identity checks
effectiveness_plan.metrics: Correctness, thinking/total tokens, caps, all per-question flips, paired bootstrap, generation time and engineering time
effectiveness_plan.promotion: Relative L27 thinking and total tokens both lower, caps no higher; accuracy loss <=2pp versus both L27 and R. Report uncertainty separately. Otherwise stop without retuning or GSM expansion.
effectiveness_plan.cost: No auxiliary model calls; no numerical time promise before native benchmark. Keep validated no-branch vLLM batch settings subject to KV capacity and preemption support.
effectiveness_plan.stop: Engineering mismatch, OOM, unsupported preemption, generation1800sec or process2400sec. Preserve partial output. No new seed or baseline rerun.
effectiveness_plan.limitations: Only weakens suppression, so compression may worsen. Dominant reflection can still be redundant or wrong. Repeatedly exposed MATH is exploratory, not independent confirmation or strict synergy proof. Hash-fixed launch package in margin_run1.
